ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a schematic diagram of China's Yellow River Delta. In the diagram, it can be seen that the lower-course channel of the Yellow River enters the sea near Dongying City, and surrounding sea areas such as the Bohai Sea and Laizhou Bay are labeled, indicating that the object of discussion is the delta formed at the place where the lower course of the Yellow River enters the sea. The question stem requires completing “humans excessively divert water, causing the downstream ________ to decrease.” “Diverting water” is taking water away from a river. Humans excessively diverting water will cause the water obtained by the lower course of the Yellow River to decrease, that is, the downstream water volume decreases. Therefore, the blank should be filled with “water volume.”
